meta.title: The buying company cannot bid on its own event
gaps: The available vocabulary cannot send POST /v1/bids with the buying company's own company id as a non-surrogate bid; EDGE-BID-098 tests a missing company id instead.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the bid call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error.
